title: Mars Base 7, Part 6: The Canyon
sources: Characters, bases and events are fictional (SCIFI series)

lines.text: Mars Base Seven. Sol six. Mei, Tomas, Pip, and me, driving to the canyon.
Tomas took the rover. Mei sat in the back, holding the seed tin, and said nothing.
Pip rode on the dashboard, beeping, Hiro, Hiro, Hiro.
The oxygen counter said five sols.
Lena's voice crackled on the radio: Keep left of the red rocks. Then follow the lights.
And then we saw them. A row of tiny lights, high on the canyon wall, blinking in the same pattern as Mei's note.
Base Three was real. And it was awake.
Tomas stopped the rover and whispered, Nobody touches anything.
She knocked on the door. Three slow knocks, like the Morse machine.
And from the other side, someone knocked back.
The door slid open. A tired man in an old orange suit stood there, with Mei's eyes.
Mei, he said. You came close. Good.
Then he looked past us, into the dark canyon, and went pale.
Quick, everyone inside. Don't say a word. It heard you arrive.
The oxygen counter said four sols.
